text:
maya: Heads-up — after the KMS rewrap last night a few prod customers reported 403s from embeddings routes. I can reproduce with a dev token. :eyes:
jon: repro steps? sample request?
maya: curl to /v1/embeddings with a token that previously worked. Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n{
  \"error\": \"permission_denied\",\n  \"message\": \"route scopes do not allow embeddings.write\"
}
```
alex: interesting — did we change per-route scope tags on the rewrap? KMS metadata is supposed to carry allowlist tags.
samir: I saw a handful of audit entries for key-rewrap, but they look truncated. sec-bot logged a rewrap event: `kms.rewrap keyId=kk-42 rewrapBy=ops@` but no `route-scopes` blob. :thinking_face:
tasha: if the rewrap dropped the keytag that maps tokens->routes then the authz layer would fall back to the legacy behavior. Do we fall back permissively? That would be bad.
jon: i checked authz: the code path has a fallthrough where missing keytag results in `scope:nil` which then ORs with token scopes. There's a subtle bug where `nil` is treated as wildcard for embeddings route matching. I'll paste the grep.
```
// authz.go (simplified)
if keytag == nil {
  // legacy: allow token scope
  return allowIfTokenScopeMatches()
}
```
jon: that appears to be the culprit — permissive if keytag missing.
maya: confirmed — when keytag is missing the embeddings route matched because token had `chat,embeddings` union in some older tokens. However some tokens leaked `chat` only and shouldn't have matched embeddings.
alex: check audit log for the specific token ID. Do we have the original KMS tag values persisted anywhere?
samir: we have an older snapshot in S3 from 2026-02-14 that still contains keytag manifests. I'll try to diff them.
sec-bot: INCIDENT: potential scope regression detected — auto-alert triggered for 6 distinct tokens failing embeddings authz (false positives). See incident-ops thread.
tasha: short-term mitigation: push a patch to authz that treats missing keytag as `deny` (most restrictive) instead of legacy `allow` and require explicit token-scope match. That will stop permissive fallback. Can we hotfix?
jon: yes I can prepare a canary patch and push to staging now. Will also add a feature-flag so we can revert if we see regressions.
maya: long-term: we need to ensure KMS rewrap copies metadata tags or we fail the rewrap early. Ops: don't rewrap until we have a safe-copy mechanism.
alex: ops question — was the rewrap performed via the rewrap-service (wrap-v2) or manually? If manual, we might not have preserved tags.
samir: it was automated; looks like the rewrap job used the `preserveTags=false` flag for one rotation batch due to an edge-case throughput optimization. We need to audit that path.
tasha: action items:
- jon: patch authz to deny on missing keytag and ship canary (priority P0) :lock:
- samir: restore keytag manifests from S3 snapshot and generate a re-tag plan :mag:
- alex: audit rewrap job history and find the job that used preserveTags=false :clipboard:
- maya: notify CS teams and affected customers with a brief status update :phone:

jon: I'll push a PR and request an expedited review. PR will include unit tests for the missing-keytag branch and a config flag `authz.strict_missing_keytag=true`.
samir: restore script started: `./tools/restore-keytags --from s3://redwood-kms-snapshots/2026-02-14 --dry-run` — returns 14 keys that lost tags.
alex: good catch on the audit truncation — I'm filing an infra ticket to increase event payload retention for kms.rewrap events.
maya: question: any possibility token rotation invalidates scopes in provider? We should also verify tokens minted around the rotation time.
jon: tokens minted after the rewrap are fine; the issue is older tokens whose effective allowlist relied on the keytag blob.
tasha: once canary is up we'll coordinate a small maintenance window to reapply tags and rotate a small percentage of tokens just to test the happy path. Notify legal/cc.
sec-bot: REMINDER: please attach incident notes to ticket SEC-2026-114 and add labels `scope-regression` `kms-rotation`
maya: thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer communication and post in #incidents. If you hit any nontrivial blockers ping @oncall. :thumbsup:
jon: patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/authz/pull/498 — tests + deploy plan attached.
samir: re-tag dry-run looks good; prepping a plan to apply tags in a rate-limited way to avoid load spikes.
alex: once re-tags applied I'll re-run the authz test harness across routes (embeddings/chat/rerank) and post results here.
tasha: agreed — after verif we'll schedule a broader rotation with preserved-tags flag enforced.
maya: closing loop: primary mitigation (deny-on-missing-keytag) will reduce blast radius. Follow-ups: re-tag restore, rewrap audit, deploy strict-preserve enforcement.
jon: updating PR with canary settings now.
maya: appreciate the quick responses. We'll triage any fallout in the incident thread.
